name: TELEMO Use Cases

image_generation.model_note: This tool does not expose a model selector, so the exact model version cannot be verified.
image_generation.shared_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide horizontal photograph for one card in a Japanese AI sales landing page, 2.4:1 composition. Style: premium Japanese corporate editorial photography, cool blue and clean white color grade, natural light, realistic details, sharp main subject, no graphic design. Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no borders, no collages.

headline: こんな営業をしている会社に。
subheadline: TELEMOは、業種や規模を問わず、さまざまな営業シーンでご活用いただけます。

cards.title: 新規法人営業
cards.description: これまでアプローチできなかった企業へ、効率的にリーチできます。
cards.scene_prompt: Card 01, new corporate sales: low angle view looking upward at two modern glass office towers against a vivid blue sky with white clouds, dynamic architecture, Tokyo business district, no people.

cards.title: 大量リストへのアプローチ
cards.description: 数万件規模のリストにも、安定した品質で架電が可能です。
cards.scene_prompt: Card 02, outreach to a large prospect list: close view of a neat tall stack of white printed business documents on a desk, softly blurred spreadsheet sheets in the background, bright cool office lighting, no readable letters or numbers.

cards.title: テレアポ
cards.description: 受付突破から担当者接続、温度確認、トスまで対応します。
cards.scene_prompt: Card 03, telephone appointment setting: professional Japanese female call center representative wearing a discreet headset, side profile facing right, coworkers softly out of focus behind her, bright modern office, calm competent expression.

cards.title: 営業代行を利用している
cards.description: 外部に頼らず、自社でコントロールできる営業基盤を構築できます。
cards.scene_prompt: Card 04, moving from outsourced sales to in-house control: close crop of two businesspeople in dark suits shaking hands across a meeting table, faces outside frame, professional partnership, blue white office background.

cards.title: 休眠顧客の掘り起こし
cards.description: 過去の顧客リストへ再アプローチし、眠っているニーズを発掘します。
cards.scene_prompt: Card 05, reactivating dormant customers: close-up of orderly white client folders in a modern filing cabinet, one tab pulled slightly forward, soft gray-blue office light, no legible labels.

cards.title: 見込み顧客への再アプローチ
cards.description: 一度接点のあった見込み顧客へ、適切なタイミングで再架電できます。
cards.scene_prompt: Card 06, following up a warm prospect: crop of a Japanese businessperson in a dark suit holding and checking a smartphone in a bright office, lower face and hands visible, shallow depth of field, phone screen hidden or unreadable.

cards.title: 営業人員の採用・教育に悩んでいる
cards.description: 採用コストや教育コストを抑え、即戦力の営業活動を実現できます。
cards.scene_prompt: Card 07, reducing sales hiring and training burden: calm bright office desk with open notebook, pen, closed laptop and a small stack of documents, no people, ample natural window light, modern professional workspace.

cards.title: トップ営業のやり方を組織に残したい
cards.description: トップ営業のトークやノウハウを仕組み化し、組織全体で再現できます。
cards.scene_prompt: Card 08, preserving top salesperson know-how: rear view of a single Japanese businessperson in dark navy suit standing at a high-rise office window, looking out over a blue city skyline at sunrise, person on the right side, city visible across left and center.
